study_identification_part.si4_title: Microstructural mapping of neural pathways in Alzheimer's disease using macrostructure-informed normative tractometry

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The abstract and methods clearly state objectives: proposing the macrostructure-informed normative tractometry (MINT) framework to jointly model white-matter micro- and macrostructure, comparing MINT-derived metrics with univariate DTI metrics, and examining relationships with clinical measures. This satisfies both criteria (explicit research aims and purpose of applying normative modeling).
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: METHODS: We propose a novel macrostructure-informed normative tractometry (MINT) framework to investigate how white matter (WM) microstructure and macrostructure are jointly altered in MCI and dementia. We compared MINT-derived metrics with univariate diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) metrics... We also examine how WM abnormalities relate to clinical measures of dementia severity.
